items.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: This one guy, Moon Mullens, would illustrate stuff for us. He was very good. ... He was very helpful in that way.

ctx.x: Who else was arranging for the band, besides Wilkins, at that point?
There was a man named Moon Mullens, a man named Quincy Jones, who wrote a lot for them.
Was he also in the trumpet section?
